mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM merchant_fee_rule r LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND m.id = r.merchant_id LEFT JOIN merchant_app a ON a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND a.id = r.merchant_app_id

SELECT r.id AS id, r.tenant_id AS tenantId,
t.name AS tenantName,
NULL AS tenantName,
r.merchant_id AS merchantId, m.merchant_short_name AS merchantName, r.merchant_app_id AS merchantAppId, a.app_name AS merchantAppName, r.rule_name AS ruleName, r.direction AS direction, r.country_code AS countryCode, r.currency AS currency, r.method_code AS methodCode, r.min_amount AS minAmount, r.max_amount AS maxAmount, r.fee_mode AS feeMode, r.fee_rate AS feeRate, r.fee_fixed AS feeFixed, r.min_fee AS minFee, r.max_fee AS maxFee, r.fee_bearer AS feeBearer, r.settle_mode AS settleMode, r.priority AS priority, r.effective_at AS effectiveAt, r.expire_at AS expireAt, r.status AS status, r.remark AS remark, r.created_by AS createdBy, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_by AS updatedBy, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM merchant_fee_rule r LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND m.id = r.merchant_id LEFT JOIN merchant_app a ON a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND a.id = r.merchant_app_id
LEFT JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = r.tenant_id
ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{limitValue} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT * FROM merchant_fee_rule WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND direction = #{direction} AND currency = #{currency} AND status = #{status} AND (merchant_app_id = #{merchantAppId} OR merchant_app_id IS NULL)
AND (country_code = #{countryCode} OR country_code IS NULL OR country_code = '')
AND (method_code = #{methodCode} OR method_code IS NULL OR method_code = '') AND (min_amount <= #{orderAmount} OR min_amount IS NULL OR min_amount <= 0) AND (max_amount >= #{orderAmount} OR max_amount IS NULL OR max_amount = 0) AND (effective_at <= #{now} OR effective_at IS NULL) AND (expire_at > #{now} OR expire_at IS NULL) ORDER BY ( CASE WHEN merchant_app_id = #{merchantAppId} THEN 8 ELSE 0 END +
CASE WHEN country_code = #{countryCode} THEN 4 ELSE 0 END +
CASE WHEN #{methodCode} != '' AND method_code = #{methodCode} THEN 2 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN (min_amount IS NOT NULL AND min_amount > 0) OR (max_amount IS NOT NULL AND max_amount > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) DESC, priority ASC, id DESC LIMIT 1
